chunks: Muhammad ibn Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Hamid ibn Shu'aib narrated to us, he said: Shurayh ibn Yunis narrated to us, he said: Wakee' narrated from Sufyan from Zayd ibn Aslam, who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) was asked about the fasting of Rajab, so he said: 'Where are you regarding Shaban?'

key_terms.رَجَب: Rajab (one of the four sacred months in the Islamic calendar)
key_terms.شَعْبَان: Shaban (the eighth month of the Islamic calendar, preceding Ramadan)

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say when asked about fasting in Rajab?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Thawab al-A'mal*, the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) redirects the inquiry regarding Rajab fasting to Shaban, a tradition widely cited by Shia scholars to emphasize the superior merit of Shaban, particularly the fasting of the 15th of Shaban (Laylat al-Bara'at). This response highlights the Prophetic preference for Shaban as a month of spiritual preparation and divine forgiveness, often viewed as a bridge between Rajab and Ramadan.
